{{Quote|Allow me to take a scout ship, my predor!|Trill, to Predor Skal'nas|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Rakatan scout ship''' was a wing shaped [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]].

==History==
During the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatas']] expansions into the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], the Infinite Empire warship [[Devourer (Rakatan ship)|''Devourer'']] was seemingly lost. This led to [[Predor]] [[Skal'nas]] dispatching his [[Force Hound]] [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill]] to track down [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] presence of her former brood mate [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]]. As a result, Trill used a Rakatan scout ship as she attempted to track Xesh down to the Force rich world in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]].
